posts.meta_description:
461 likes, 13 comments - travelandleisure on October 17, 2026: "An oyster’s story doesn’t end when you eat it. At the Food & Wine Classic in Charleston—happening November 13-15—it’s also part of a bigger story about protecting the Lowcountry’s coast. The Food & Wine Classic in Charleston has partnered with SCORE to spotlight the importance of oyster shell recycling—and celebrate the coastal culture that makes this destination so special.

Experience that culture for yourself at Pearls of the Coast: A Lowcountry Oyster Roast, a Travel + Leisure event on Nov. 13. Gather around live-fire oysters, an abundant raw bar, cocktails, fine wines, and live music for an evening rooted in the flavors and traditions of the Lowcountry.

You can purchase a ticket to the Lowcountry Oyster Roast on its own or get a pass for the full weekend: 3 unforgettable days with 60+ celebrity and local chefs, 4 Grand Tastings with 100+ samplings, 40+ expert-led demos, and more.

Discover Charleston through its coastal traditions. Get your Lowcountry Oyster Roast tickets or Classic passes NOW at the link in our bio.".
